title: The project the connection is rooted at

projectId.description: The project id (the root's name and canonical key)

projectNumber.description: The numeric project number; null when the identity may not read the project resource (the run reports permission_denied scoped project)

displayName.description: The project's display name; null as above

lifecycleState.description: ACTIVE, DELETE_REQUESTED or another resourcemanager state; null as above
